tasks.title: Level 1's fighter and interceptor spawns, their legacy density and the station's rail reinforcements firing are pinned before anything changes
tasks.description:
Plan §2.9.1. New tests/integration/test_level1_fighter_spawns.gd pins every b.fighter()/b.interceptor() entry of Level1Director._build_sections() from data (section, trigger, offset, delay, formation type/size, aim_mode prop, free_after, whether movement is set). Per section it computes the legacy peak concurrent fighters and the legacy peak shots/s (aimed 1/0.8, forward 1/0.3, interceptor 1/0.09 per alive shooter), with each rail's lifetime = free_after, or its MovementResource sampled (x WORLD_SCALE, from its offset) until it leaves ArenaCamera.enemy_cull_rect(), capped at 20 s. Generalise tests/helpers/level1_drone_concurrency.gd to take a lifetime function per kind. FREEZE the results as constants _LEGACY_PEAK_FIGHTERS and _LEGACY_PEAK_SHOTS_PER_S (the Ph2 _EXPECTED_LEGACY_PEAKS shape), filled in from the first computed run, and assert the live computation equals them. Later tasks (t16/t17) delete the rails and divide by these constants. Add test_station_reinforcements.gd::test_rail_reinforcements_fire (every TOP fighter and LEFT/RIGHT interceptor fires >= 1 bullet within 2 s; a FORWARD rail fighter's shot lies along its travel, compared with angle_difference) and read the interceptor half-extent from the scene instead of the literal 37 (C13). No production code changes.

Extend test_enemy_bullet_lifetime.gd into a per-round sweep, max_distance / min_fired_speed <= max_time plus the range floor (>= 1280 px except Scatter). Speed sources stay the ones that exist today: the regex over light_assault_ship.gd and InterceptorConfig. A round with no shooter yet is checked at its scene speed. tasks.title: The Fighter flies attack runs: it passes a set distance beside the player, bursts, makes a visible wide turn and comes back, choosing an aimed or a close-range burst by distance
tasks.description:
Plan §2.4.1 and §2.4.2. Pass geometry: bearing b, run direction u = -b, lane l perpendicular to u. The start point S = P_hat + b*standoff_radius + l lies on the pass line, so the closest approach equals |l|. Pass kinds FLANK_LEFT/FLANK_RIGHT-shaped (lanes ahead of the player, pass_offset and pass_offset + flank_lane_gap), FRONTAL (lane right(h)*sigma*pass_offset) and solo alternation. APPROACH seeks the first S. RUN_IN is path following with a lookahead point (never stalls) and ends when (P_hat - X).u < 0. EXTEND (>= 350 px, 0.6-1.5 s). TURN via turn_toward. REPOSITION seeks S, routed round the player outside reposition_min_radius. Assault: clamps into inner_rect(), the lane flips behind near the corridor top, and the bearing flips when the run would be shorter than min_run_length. Weapons: opportunities (a) and (b), mode by distance with hysteresis, FORWARD taken only with the nose within nose_cone_deg (otherwise skipped, not spent), latched per burst, weapon_mode_changed(mode: int), a 0.3 s CHARGING telegraph then ARMED via BurstClock. Budget expiry during a telegraph or burst defers DISENGAGE to the burst's end (<= 0.8 s).

Plan: docs/plans/cmufs7ekv000lnm2x7nbswijy/3-plan.md (Revision 2).
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: The t8b rows of plan §4 pass in both harnesses. Open Space closest approach is pass_offset +-40 (FLANK_LEFT, FRONTAL) and pass_offset+flank_lane_gap +-40 (FLANK_RIGHT) on the stated side, for a holding and a moving player, matching §2.4.1's worked check. The TURN radius is within 15%. There is no hurtbox overlap. RUN_IN's seek target is always ahead. The Assault lateral-pass, lane-flip and min_run_length boundaries hold. The weapon-selection boundaries hold: 250/400/330 hysteresis, off-nose FORWARD skipped, no mid-burst change. Cadence is within one tick. Deferred DISENGAGE is within 0.8 s. The t1 pin and station rail test stay green. All invariant gates are green. check-test-leaks is clean.

tasks.title: Three fighters close as a pincer while a fourth comes head-on, extra fighters wait their turn, and a fallen fighter's place is taken at once

The LEAD opens attack_window_open on RUN_IN entry (only while it leads) and closes it on its own EXTEND entry. Flanks loiter at S, answer each window once (_answered_window, reset on reading it closed) and go anyway after flank_wait_max. The pass (_pass_role, b, u, l) is latched at RUN_IN entry; a new pass kind is taken only through REPOSITION, whose seek target never passes within reposition_min_radius. tasks.title: The Gatling Interceptor holds side-on range and fires readable pressure windows — yellow spin-up, one 8–12 round stream, a pause, then a swing to the other flank — and still fires on rails
tasks.description:
Plan §2.6 and §2.8 (Gatling half). GatlingInterceptorBrain (APPROACH, SWING_IN, SPIN_UP, STREAM, COOLDOWN, REPOSITION, DISENGAGE). The scene has EnemyMover (AUTO), StateLight, one driven_by_brain controller, and StreamPool (Gatling Stream, 36) as a DIRECT CHILD OF THE ROOT, plus a per-instance GatlingAttackPattern with the brain rng. Side rule: the first window takes its current side (Open Space) or the corridor half opposite the player's x (Assault); REPOSITION flips side for every later window, except in Assault when the flipped point would be closer than min_flank_range to the player. SWING_IN is entered only with remaining budget >= swing_in_max; expiry in SWING_IN/SPIN_UP/STREAM defers DISENGAGE to COOLDOWN entry. Rail fallback: the legacy constant stream from config fields (rail_stream_interval 0.09, rail_stream_speed 220, rail_spread 0.08); the rail keeps the legacy pool-starvation shape (pool 36, not 71), named as deliberate. Switch test_enemy_bullet_lifetime.gd to GatlingInterceptorConfig fields (round_speed, rail_stream_speed). Dual-mode specs in tests/integration/test_gatling_interceptor.gd and test_enemy_dual_mode.gd.

tasks.title: Two Gatling Interceptors charge together and cross their streams at the player's likely next position from the same side, leaving the other side open
tasks.description:
Plan §2.6.1 (resequenced). The LEAD opens the window at its SWING_IN entry and writes squad.convergence_point every tick until close. A FLANK within 1.5 x preferred_range answers once on its next tick: it enters SWING_IN (CHARGING) toward its flank point on the LEAD's side, rotated 40 deg toward h. Rendezvous in SPIN_UP via convergence_stage: STREAM starts when every participant is ready or after sync_wait_max (0.75 s). Each shooter aims at the refreshed point with a +-3 deg per-window error. Stage 2 on COOLDOWN. The LEAD closes the window on the LATER COOLDOWN entry. leave() erases a dead participant; a LEAD change clears everything, and a FLANK mid-stream finishes at its own predicted point. The LEAD opens no new window while one is open. New tests/integration/test_gatling_convergence.gd.
